spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact CSS Color 4 issue-5900 contract: computed color of a child with color: AccentColor compared for strict equality against the host's canonicalised accent-color, with AccentColorText read alongside; no proxy surfaces.

interactive.rationale: A real color input re-runs the probe on every input event, a re-run button repeats it on demand, and all four readout rows plus both swatches update from getComputedStyle() — no static card.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a one-comparison behavioral probe with three honest verdicts; the page delivers exactly that verdict triad (follows / legacy-global / keyword-unparsed).

edge_cases.rationale: Covers keyword-not-parsed (pre-157 non-web-app contexts), legacy OS-accent resolution with the Forced Colors caveat named, and the followed-value case; the keyword swatch carries a labelled design-system fallback so an unsupported state is never a fake pass.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6207138742534144 and the AccentColor spec section on the page; the feature index adds issue 5900 and the css-ui-4 widget-accent section.

conformance.rationale: New 8-assertion feature suite covers keyword parsing, the follows-value computed equality, per-element resolution, AccentColorText luminance flip, accent-color inheritance and the auto initial value; on this container's Chromium 141 it executes 3 pass / 5 fail (honest unsupported), 0 blocked.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): picker driven to #8b0000, re-run clicked, readouts updated (accent rgb(139,0,0)), verdict stayed in the honest keyword-unsupported branch, zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px horizontal overflow, desktop screenshot read. Partial: the 157 follows-value branch could not execute on this pre-157 build, so only the unsupported branch has browser evidence.

telemetry_health.rationale: accentcolor-probe-ran and accentcolor-honest-verdict assertions fire once on load with branch-accurate conditions; no noisy console paths.

design_system.rationale: All chrome colors are design-system variables; the picked swatch picks its label ink by computed luminance so user-chosen accents never produce unreadable labels; verdict colors sit on bg-stone/bg-paper at AA.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled color input and button (44px min targets), definition-list readout, verdict is an aria-live=polite element, focus styles come from the shared stylesheet, swatch information is duplicated in text readouts so color is never the only channel.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow (0px), console/network clean, both screenshots read; readout grid collapses to one column under 480px.

openQuestions.title: Verify the follows-value verdict on a Chrome 157+ build
openQuestions.detail: This container's Chromium 141 does not parse AccentColor in a normal browsing context, so only the keyword-unsupported verdict ran in-browser. On Chrome 157+, confirm the probe reports 'Follows the value' with the computed equality shown, and that the conformance route reaches 8/8.

guidanceConsulted.query: color input live preview computed style readout accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Don't use color alone to indicate state; maintain AA contrast; use forced-color-adjust: none only where color IS the information (color picker swatch).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Swatches carry forced-color-adjust: none because the rendered color is the demonstrated information, every color is also reported as text in the readout dl, and verdicts pair color with explicit wording.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status readout for probe result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region per changing surface; native controls with programmatic labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict paragraph is the single aria-live=polite region; the color input has a for/id label and the re-run control is a native button.

summary: Behavioral probe for the Chrome 157 AccentColor-follows-accent-color resolution with a three-way honest verdict, driven in headless Chromium 141 (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): picker and re-run exercised, readouts tracked computed values, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
